of abelian branched coverings of (M, L). Let G be a finite abelian group and π :

cover corresponding to π, that is, the Fox completion of the unbranched covering
corresponding to ker π. Then the transformation group of Mπ →M is G. Note that
any finite abelian cover of M branched along L is obtained in this way.
